mapper.insert: insert into rabbit_status_history (house_id, rabbit_id, batch_id, from_status, to_status, change_time, reason, related_record_id, related_record_table, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{rabbitId}, #{batchId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{changeTime}, #{reason}, #{relatedRecordId}, #{relatedRecordTable}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select h.* from rabbit_status_history h inner join rabbits r on r.id = h.rabbit_id where h.house_id = #{houseId} and r.house_id = #{houseId} and h.rabbit_id = #{rabbitId} order by h.change_time desc, h.id desc
